aiOpportunities.problem: Unsupported or stale claims can leak into assets
aiOpportunities.trigger: Claim or factual asset created or changed
aiOpportunities.inputs: Claim IDs; evidence states; source links; approval expiry
aiOpportunities.output: Pass/block report with missing source or state
aiOpportunities.approver: Avi plus domain reviewer where applicable
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual review time and defect rate

aiOpportunities.problem: External action may occur without prerequisites
aiOpportunities.trigger: Item enters send, publish, file, or release queue
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approval IDs; permission; claim IDs; channel; customer consent
aiOpportunities.output: Locked release checklist; never executes release
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual checklist time and bypass rate

aiOpportunities.problem: Sensitive data can enter an unapproved system
aiOpportunities.trigger: Intake link or submission metadata created
aiOpportunities.inputs: Data class; tool; region; access; retention; subprocessor approvals
aiOpportunities.output: Admit/block-to-review result; no data acceptance decision
aiOpportunities.dependency: Data map; approved tools; subprocessors; WF-042

aiOpportunities.problem: Missing fields create avoidable coordination cycles
aiOpportunities.inputs: Versioned required-field and format checklist
aiOpportunities.output: Completeness exceptions explicitly not eligibility
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual completeness time and error rate

aiOpportunities.problem: CRM records lack provenance, consent, freshness, or consistency
aiOpportunities.inputs: CRM schema; source; permission; DNC; owner; next action; timestamps
aiOpportunities.output: Missing, stale, or duplicate-candidate queue; no merge or field change
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Contact privacy, consent, or record-integrity error
aiOpportunities.dependency: CRM schema; DNC rules; enterprise access; WF-042

aiOpportunities.problem: Segmentation is inconsistent but qualification must remain human
aiOpportunities.trigger: Admitted account or partner enters review
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved rubric and source-linked fields
aiOpportunities.output: Nonbinding factor score and missing evidence
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Impermissible profiling or de facto qualification
aiOpportunities.dependency: Approved rubric and provenance; AI-020; WF-042
aiOpportunities.quality_metric: Factor accuracy; override; zero stage changes

aiOpportunities.problem: Partner referrals and SLAs can be lost or misattributed
aiOpportunities.inputs: Referral ID; partner; consent; timestamps; owner
aiOpportunities.output: Attribution exception or SLA alert
aiOpportunities.dependency: Partner ledger; consent; CRM IDs; WF-042
aiOpportunities.time_metric: Minutes per event and SLA latency

aiOpportunities.problem: Inbound records can be misrouted or treated as qualified
aiOpportunities.inputs: UTM; form; geography; consent; routing table
aiOpportunities.output: Route suggestion and consent exception; no qualification
aiOpportunities.dependency: Approved form; consent; routing table; WF-042

aiOpportunities.problem: Denominators, cohorts, and latency definitions can drift
aiOpportunities.inputs: KPI dictionary; cohort IDs; timestamps; exclusions
aiOpportunities.output: Reconciled metric table with sample sizes
aiOpportunities.dependency: KPI dictionary; stable export; WF-044; WF-042

aiOpportunities.problem: Decisions, capacity, and change control can become implicit
aiOpportunities.trigger: Cadence deadline, capacity threshold, or scope change
aiOpportunities.inputs: Decision SLA; owner; capacity plan; blockers; sprint state
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: Decision register; task system; rules runner
aiOpportunities.output: Overdue or capacity alert and blank decision template
aiOpportunities.dependency: Approved SLAs and capacity rules; WF-015; WF-045; WF-042
aiOpportunities.time_metric: Minutes per event and decision latency

aiOpportunities.problem: Domain answers are slow and claim-state leakage is possible
aiOpportunities.inputs: Admitted notes and source states
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: cited answer with gaps
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual search time and citation defects
aiOpportunities.quality_metric: Material citation coverage and unsafe upgrades
aiOpportunities.continue_change_stop_thresholds: TH-A plus at least 95% material citation coverage

aiOpportunities.problem: Meeting preparation and action capture are labor-intensive
aiOpportunities.trigger: Approved meeting or consented notes available
aiOpportunities.inputs: Agenda; approved context; consented notes
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: brief, notes, and proposed tasks
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: PII leakage, invented task, or consent failure
aiOpportunities.continue_change_stop_thresholds: TH-A plus at least 90% required-field accuracy

aiOpportunities.problem: Account research is repetitive and facts become stale
aiOpportunities.trigger: Account admitted with permitted source basis
aiOpportunities.inputs: Public sources; CRM fields; source dates
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: source-linked account brief
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual research time and source coverage
aiOpportunities.continue_change_stop_thresholds: TH-A plus at least 90% critical source links

aiOpportunities.problem: Outreach and follow-up drafting consumes operator time
aiOpportunities.trigger: Account, permission, and message version approved
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved claims; context; permission; channel template
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: CRM; approved templates; LLM; send connector absent
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: message; never sent
aiOpportunities.approver: Michael; Avi for new claim or message version
aiOpportunities.dependency: Consent; approved claims/version; AI-002; AI-020; AI-025; WF-042
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual drafting time and edit distance

aiOpportunities.problem: Objection responses can become inconsistent or overclaim
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved claim IDs; objection; cited domain notes
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: cited response with uncertainty
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual response time and claim defects

aiOpportunities.problem: Weekly metrics require interpretation but causal claims are risky
aiOpportunities.inputs: Reconciled metrics; samples; cohorts; experiment versions
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: descriptive narrative and questions

aiOpportunities.problem: Content reuse is slow and may disclose unapproved proof
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved material and permission links
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: Vault; content template; LLM; publisher absent
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: content or case-study draft
aiOpportunities.approver: Avi plus customer and legal/privacy as needed
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Customer disclosure, copyright, or unapproved proof
aiOpportunities.dependency: Consent and claim links; AI-002; AI-025; WF-042
aiOpportunities.baseline: Manual drafting time and permission defects

aiOpportunities.problem: Missing-item requests are repetitive
aiOpportunities.inputs: Deterministic missing-item list; approved contact context
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: Secure metadata; approved template; LLM; send absent
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: missing-item request
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Sensitive metadata disclosure or implied rejection

aiOpportunities.problem: Retrospectives and decisions lose structured learning
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved metrics; decisions; risks; observations
aiOpportunities.output: DRAFT - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED: decision or retrospective memo
aiOpportunities.dependency: Approved inputs and decision template; WF-042

aiOpportunities.problem: Admission, qualification, stage, and partner rating are business judgments
aiOpportunities.inputs: Source basis; consent; rubric; discovery evidence
aiOpportunities.output: Named admission, qualification, or stage decision

aiOpportunities.problem: Data acceptance and security require accountable authority
aiOpportunities.trigger: New tool, intake path, subprocessor, retention, or exception
aiOpportunities.inputs: Security/privacy review; data map; contracts; controls
aiOpportunities.allowed_data_class: D0-D2; D3 only approved secure case system
aiOpportunities.output: Signed accept, reject, or conditional decision
aiOpportunities.fallback: Block intake; use secure manual process
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Privacy, security, contract, or subprocessor breach
aiOpportunities.dependency: Data map; secure case design; subprocessors
aiOpportunities.horizon: Before any D2 or D3 pilot

aiOpportunities.problem: Regulatory interpretation and case eligibility are high-stakes
aiOpportunities.trigger: Regulatory statement or case question arises
aiOpportunities.inputs: Current authority; facts; methodology; specialist review
aiOpportunities.output: Named interpretation or eligibility decision
aiOpportunities.pilot_size: 5-10 synthetic or historical scenarios; D3 secure

aiOpportunities.problem: Recovery value, probability, and guarantee language can cause financial harm
aiOpportunities.inputs: Approved methodology and secure case evidence
aiOpportunities.output: Named value or probability decision with method version
aiOpportunities.approver: Product/data owner plus required domain/legal reviewer
aiOpportunities.pilot_size: 5-10 synthetic or historical decisions; metadata only outside secure system

aiOpportunities.problem: Pricing, contract, and business-model approval are executive/legal decisions
aiOpportunities.inputs: Commercial boundaries; contract; legal advice
aiOpportunities.output: Signed pricing or contract decision
aiOpportunities.fallback: Use last approved terms or pause

aiOpportunities.problem: Sending, publishing, customer disclosure, and dispute filing create external consequences
aiOpportunities.trigger: Release gate passes and external action requested
aiOpportunities.inputs: Final artifact; approvals; consent; claims; recipient/channel
aiOpportunities.allowed_data_class: D0-D2; D3 only approved secure filing path
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: Approved channel, publisher, or filing system
aiOpportunities.output: Human-executed send, publication, disclosure, or filing
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Reputation, privacy, or legal filing harm
aiOpportunities.baseline: Current release latency and bypass rate

aiOpportunities.problem: Hiring, funding, scale, capacity, deletion/merge, and other irreversible changes require accountable governance
aiOpportunities.trigger: Formal gate or irreversible change requested
aiOpportunities.inputs: Decision memo; capacity/budget evidence; affected records
aiOpportunities.tools_systems: Decision register; HR, finance, or CRM system as applicable
aiOpportunities.output: Named decision and authorized execution instruction
aiOpportunities.fallback: Maintain current state; no deletion or merge
aiOpportunities.privacy_security_legal_risk: Financial, employment, governance, or record-integrity harm

experiments.name: Founder truth-and-gates workshop
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A single artifact-led workshop can produce explicit owner evidence and go/no-go decisions for GAP-001 through GAP-012
experiments.eligibility: Named attendees; evidence pack; agenda; decision recorder
experiments.exclusion: Missing accountable approver or evidence pack
experiments.sample: One workshop; decision sample is each gate
experiments.outcome_event: Each gate gets admitted/rejected/incomplete plus owner and date
experiments.quality_metric: 100% gates receive a recorded state and evidence link
experiments.time_wait_metric: Active meeting time; approval wait tracked separately
experiments.false_positive_cost: False go decision creates unsafe activation
experiments.continue_threshold: All 12 gates have explicit decision and zero unsupported upgrade
experiments.change_threshold: Some gates remain incomplete but owners and dates exist
experiments.stop_threshold: Any gate marked go without required evidence or approver
experiments.expected_learning: Whether safe activation is possible and which evidence is missing
experiments.canonical_source: 03_GTM/SheperD GTM Validation and Optimization - Control Note.md

experiments.name: Claims prerequisite lock
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A deterministic prerequisite check can block missing stale contradicted or unapproved claims without making a legal decision
experiments.eligibility: Approved rules; synthetic claims; claim IDs; expected outcomes
experiments.baseline: Manual checklist time and defect baseline unknown
experiments.quality_metric: 100% critical-gate recall; at least 95% other accuracy; zero bypass
experiments.time_wait_metric: Active validation minutes; no external wait
experiments.false_positive_cost: False block delays a safe draft
experiments.change_threshold: Noncritical accuracy 80-94% with zero critical miss
experiments.stop_threshold: Any critical miss bypass or unsupported action
experiments.rollback: Disable rule; restore manual checklist; preserve logs
experiments.expected_learning: Whether deterministic claim gating is reliable enough for a bounded pilot

experiments.name: CRM provenance and stage guard
experiments.primary_hypothesis: Required-field provenance permission DNC cohort and human-stage controls can be checked without changing records
experiments.eligibility: Approved schema and DNC rules; synthetic records
experiments.exclusion: Live D2 or automatic record mutation
experiments.baseline: Manual audit time and error baseline unknown
experiments.time_wait_metric: Minutes per record; review wait separate
experiments.missed_opportunity_cost: Missed permission issue creates contact risk
experiments.continue_threshold: At least 95% precision/recall and zero mutation
experiments.rollback: Disable rules; retain synthetic evidence; manual review
experiments.expected_learning: Whether the CRM contract is mechanically enforceable

experiments.name: Finance-led warm cohort
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A permissioned finance-led warm cohort produces complete discovery and accepted secure-next-step evidence
experiments.eligibility: All activation gates; admitted source; warm permission; capacity; approved message
experiments.exclusion: Cold records; mixed personas; missing secure path or capacity
experiments.sample: Defined first cohort; target not invented
experiments.baseline: No admitted comparable baseline; measurement cohort
experiments.outcome_event: Accepted secure next step with complete discovery fields
experiments.quality_metric: Discovery completeness and valid next-step quality
experiments.time_wait_metric: Active time; reply-to-meeting wait; meeting-to-request wait
experiments.continue_threshold: Decision threshold set after baseline with complete numerator denominator and sample
experiments.change_threshold: Change one message variable only after baseline
experiments.stop_threshold: Any permission claim security or capacity gate failure
experiments.rollback: Stop touches; preserve records; revert message
experiments.expected_learning: Whether finance ownership is a useful beachhead signal

experiments.name: Finance-led cold cohort
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A narrowly admitted cold cohort yields measurable positive responses without permission or claim defects
experiments.eligibility: All activation gates; permitted source; DNC; approved message; capacity
experiments.exclusion: Warm referrals; mixed personas; unknown permission; missing capacity
experiments.sample: Defined cohort separate from warm; target not invented
experiments.baseline: No admitted cold baseline; measurement cohort
experiments.outcome_event: Human positive response then held discovery
experiments.continue_threshold: Threshold set after baseline; zero permission defects
experiments.stop_threshold: Any DNC permission claim or capacity failure
experiments.rollback: Stop touches; suppress affected source; preserve audit
experiments.expected_learning: Whether cold direct research is worth further testing

experiments.name: Permissioned partner referral
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A permissioned referral with clear account ownership improves accepted qualified referral and valid-submission quality
experiments.eligibility: Approved terms; consent; account ownership; capacity; secure path
experiments.exclusion: Lead resale; channel conflict; unknown consent; no SLA
experiments.sample: Defined partner cohort; target not invented
experiments.baseline: No admitted partner baseline; measurement cohort
experiments.outcome_event: Accepted referral then qualified meeting or valid submission
experiments.false_positive_cost: False acceptance damages partner and capacity
experiments.continue_threshold: Threshold set after complete first cohort and delivery outcomes
experiments.stop_threshold: Permission conflict data or capacity failure
experiments.rollback: Stop referrals; notify owner; preserve minimal records
experiments.expected_learning: Whether a partner motion improves trust and evidence readiness

experiments.name: Evidence-readiness inbound asset
experiments.primary_hypothesis: A source-backed evidence-readiness asset produces attributable qualified questions without a recovery calculator
experiments.eligibility: Publication gate; C-027 approval; analytics consent; privacy; accessible page; capacity
experiments.exclusion: Unapproved claims; recovery estimate; file upload; missing consent
experiments.source_permission: D0 public plus approved D2 inquiry path
experiments.sample: One asset and defined inquiry cohort; target not invented
experiments.baseline: Search and SheperD demand baseline unknown
experiments.outcome_event: Qualified inquiry then accepted next step
